parts.criterion: The final vote was 12 in favour, zero against and two abstentions.
Algeria did not participate in the final vote.
S/2024/797 concerned nine consecutive years without an OHCHR visit.
S/2024/797 was rejected following a vote of 6 in favour, 0 against and 9 abstentions.
S/2024/798 proposed considering an expansion of MINURSO's mandate for human-rights monitoring.
S/2024/798 was rejected following a vote of 5 in favour, 0 against and 10 abstentions.
Algeria favoured giving MINURSO a human-rights monitoring function.
Algeria said that disregard for its views by the penholder was a reason for not participating in the final vote.
Switzerland voted in favour of S/2024/797.
Switzerland's reason for abstaining on the second amendment was to maintain MINURSO's operational continuity.

The positions on the two Swiss amendment votes are presented as Switzerland's national position. Explicitly identifying the Swiss speaker's national capacity or attributing the positions to Switzerland is sufficient.
The resolution extended the MINURSO mandate until 31 October 2025.
The adopted text urged enhanced cooperation with OHCHR including facilitating visits.
The adopted resolution did not add the monitoring functions.
